changes: pads: none → pads (groove_mm 0, lip_mm 0, pad_angle_deg 10, pad_tpu_mm 2, reach_mm 0, width_mm 12)
why: A 2 mm TPU skin (mu 0.9 > 0.65) lets the gelatin box's 33 deg contact hold, and a 10 deg pad tilt brings the face slightly nearer parallel at wide openings. reach_mm=0 avoids lengthening the swing radius, which raises the tip (pad_angle 0 at mid reach gave +27 mm at 85 mm). Cost: free, 0 days, about 16 machine minutes. This will not fix the top-face cases (73 to 85 deg). If it is combined with long_slide, the TPU still helps and a 10 deg tilt is within what mu 0.9 tolerates (tan 10 = 0.18).
